principle: unique personality does not exempt a component from responsibility boundaries
rules: shared primitives are promoted only with repeated semantic evidence
a one-off experience must still be decomposed when it mixes independent rendering, interaction, data-derivation or orchestration responsibilities
shared UI cannot depend on public-page feature implementation
public-page recipes may compose shared primitives without becoming shared primitives themselves

currentRecipes.guided-story: feature-owned and already decomposed across data, scheduler, hook, scenes and shared visual pieces
currentRecipes.theory-flow-board: feature-owned and decomposed into board composition, edge layer, stage labels, node cards and relation utilities

storybookReadiness: public APIs should remain explicit and composable so shared primitives can later be documented independently without moving domain-specific recipes into shared UI
